issues.reason: Official narrative says "2 different potential heritages" but the immediately following table lists 3: Azim, Raen, Khagan. All 3 table rows extracted. Their skill substitutes must be replaced by Imposing Figure-targeting alternates, not left applied or stacked.

Supremacy Champion is Xaela-only; Pacification and Avoidance is Raen-only. Resolve ancestry gating and selection-prerequisite evaluation before any auto-availability. Bull-Headed/Claws/Bite natural attacks need attack and size rules.
Ferocity once-per-day disabled-combat turn, natural armor type, conditional speed, bonus Weapon Focus/Dodge feats and life-below-zero handling need runtime logic. Resource refills not assumed.
All 17 race-page rewards need class-specific integration; Paladin "or" reward requires exactly one choice per pick, not both.
Independent source accuracy, safe effect ownership/conflict behavior, and production runtime integration have not been reviewed. Keep staging only; do not enable in manifest.
